catalog_metadata.description: Critical Data Element catalog — maps CDE-flagged columns to their business terms, tables, and rationale.

cdes.name: Central Index Key (CIK)
cdes.definition: Unique numeric identifier assigned by the SEC to every filing entity. Core entity identifier critical for cross-system joins and audit trails.

mappings.rationale: Part of the conformed fact grain (cik, business_term_id, fiscal_year, fiscal_period). Primary entity identifier denormalized from financial_facts for query performance.

cdes.name: Canonical Company Identity
cdes.definition: Normalized, human-approved company name that serves as the single source of truth for entity identity across the pipeline.

mappings.rationale: Denormalized from entity_mappings for query performance. Provides the authoritative company name alongside the CIK identifier.

cdes.name: Accession Number
cdes.definition: Unique identifier for each filing submitted to SEC EDGAR. Format: XXXXXXXXXX-YY-ZZZZZZ. Traces any data point back to its source filing.

mappings.rationale: Accession number of the winning fact's filing after collision resolution. Enables one-hop lineage from conformed value back to the SEC filing.

cdes.name: Filing Date
cdes.definition: Date the filing was officially submitted to and accepted by the SEC. Critical for determining the timeline of financial disclosures.

mappings.rationale: Filing date of the winning fact's source filing. Used for freshness validation and temporal ordering of disclosures.
